allowed.entry:app/surfaces.tsx: loaded lazily by `import(`./${"surfaces"}.tsx`)` in app/index.ts, a template import knip cannot follow.
allowed.entry:daemon/features/*.feature.ts: a Conversation feature is listed by the generator into the git-ignored daemon/generated/features.ts (scripts/gen/registries.ts), which knip does not read, so each feature file is an entry by its name: a new feature adds one file and edits no list (docs/standards/architecture). Not a pending-port gap.
